title: SDK accuracy unchanged: 4/6 overall, 2/4 writes
text: Both coworker writes pass; both friend writes fail. Previously one coworker and one friend write passed. Total success across all methods remains 9/18. These fresh stochastic runs do not establish an accuracy improvement.

title: Used in four successes, skipped in two failures
text: All four successful SDK episodes mention and use ContactRelationship or its traversals. Neither friend-write failure queries that surface; both mutate overly broad transaction sets. Making a constraint queryable did not ensure the model applied it.

title: A concrete successful use: owner plus exact kind
text: afc0fce_1__sdk__0 discovers ContactRelationship at turn 6, queries owner-scoped labels at turn 7, then exact kind at turn 8. It writes at turn 9 and passes at turn 10. Its previous counterpart omitted the contact-group filter.

title: No efficiency gain in this run
text: SDK mean turns 13.2 → 15.7; mean input tokens 76,814 → 113,736; mean episode time 29.3s → 34.2s. SDK redeclaration-error turns rise from 14 to 24. These reflect whole trajectories, not an isolated measure of graph-discovery overhead.

title: Graph only; prompts and SDK packages unchanged
text: Person.email replaces the ambiguous sourceId property. ContactRelationship stores owner, contact and exact kind, with canonical references and traversals. The same acquired API data and public supervisor context supply all records; acquisition call counts and exact initial messages match the preceding run.

title: Raw controls show substantial variability
text: Raw Python moves 3/6 → 4/6; raw TypeScript 2/6 → 1/6 despite unchanged environments. One raw-TS episode hits 28 turns without completing. All 18 episodes scored, with no infrastructure errors.

title: Inspect all results and matched trajectories
text: About 9.9 minutes of summed episode wall time, 332 turns and $0.1892 estimated model cost. The explorer now retains 222 trajectories. The matched-case button connects this graph experiment to the previous no-answer run.
